neighbours.label: 'from' marking the starting point of a reverse or backward traversal (count backwards from, work back from)
fire: To calm down, close your eyes and slowly count backwards from twenty.
Good planners work backwards from the deadline to set each milestone.
The detective reasoned in reverse, starting from the crime and moving back to the motive.
Reverse engineering means going backwards from the finished product to the design.
Read the list in reverse order, going upward from the last entry.
The rocket launch countdown runs backwards from ten to zero.
Start at the answer and trace the proof backwards from the conclusion.
The recipe is easier if you plan it backwards from the time you want to eat.
quiet: To calm down, she listened to a quiet song that came from the radio.
Good planners receive regular updates from every member of the team.
The detective received a mysterious letter from an old friend in Lisbon.
Many of the parts in the product are imported from factories abroad.
Read the list of guests that arrived from the hotel this morning.
The rocket was launched from a site on the southern coast.
Start with the data you collected from the survey last spring.
The recipe uses fresh tomatoes picked from the garden this morning.

notes: Card: ' from' is 20 of the top 32; top examples are 'go the other way: from', 'think backwards from your customer', 'count backwards from 100'. Near misses keep 'from' in its ordinary source sense.
